items.headline: CoreWeave 5-year CDS near 1,067 bps, up ~30% in October; unsecured bonds trade in distressed territory
items.note: Distressed-level bond pricing and ~$4.4B due by year-end make CoreWeave's refinancing a live test of neocloud credit, with high-yield issuance reportedly on hold until after the midterms.

items.headline: CoreWeave and Oracle five-year CDS hit record levels; Oracle shares fall ~9%
items.note: Record CDS on both a neocloud and a BBB-rated AI-infrastructure borrower shows credit stress spreading beyond one name.
